bottleneck.description: Wire bonders + ball bonders for IC packaging — effectively a duopoly with ASMPT for advanced wire-bonding, the mainstream IC packaging interconnect.

dependency.key_customers: OSATs (Amkor, ASE, JCET), IDM packaging operations

editorial.notes: Advanced wire-bonding is a 2-player market (KLIC + ASMPT). Wire-bond capacity remains structurally relevant even as advanced packaging grows — high pin-count BGAs and power devices continue to require wire bonders. Switching cost is multi-quarter (qualification of bond profiles for each device family). Revised from MEDIUM on the structural duopoly basis.
